newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli jets attack in northeast Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli jets attack in northeast Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes launched a raid deep into northeast Lebanon on Thursday, targeting suspected guerrilla targets near the Syria border, security sources said.

They said the air attack was aimed at suspected guerrilla targets on the banks of the Assi River in Hermel region some 55 km (33 miles) north of the city of Baalbek and 10 km (six miles) west of the border with Syria.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the raid, which followed the killing of one Israeli soldier and the wounding of three others in a Hizbollah guerrilla raid on Wednesday in south Lebanon.
In Israel, the army on Thursday confirmed one Israeli soldier was killed and three wounded in the guerrilla attack in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
The last Israeli raid into Lebanon's eastern Bekaa Valley was on February 11 when Israeli jets hit the antenna of Hizbollah's radio station just north of Baalbek, a bastion of the pro-Iranian group.

Hizbollah (Party of God) is leading a guerrilla war to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 SLA militiamen from the 15-km (nine-miles)-deep zone in south Lebanon set up by Israel to stop cross-frontier guerrilla raids on northern Israel.
